answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the forge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The spiral is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cedar. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
